selection_principles: Prefer tasks with executable tests and pinned environments.
Separate code generation, defect repair, repository work, tool use, and security.
Protect benchmark repositories and derivatives from training.

mixing_guidance: Do not start dedicated code RL until an owner, frozen benchmark policy, and executable harness exist.
Use pass/fail execution rather than teacher preference whenever possible.
Retain non-code instruction replay and track secure-code regressions.
